failure_policy: reject incomplete or over-selected IR before deterministic compilation

multiplicity_constraints.insert_assignments: column_ref values must be unique within assignments
multiplicity_constraints.mapped_slot_refs: no SLOT may appear more than once in the same mapping context
multiplicity_constraints.predicates: column_ref uniqueness is not required; repeated columns are allowed for ranges such as age > 18 AND age < 60
multiplicity_constraints.required_slot_refs: every required SLOT must appear exactly once in its relevant mapping context
multiplicity_constraints.update_assignments: column_ref values must be unique within assignments
multiplicity_constraints.upsert_cross_branch_column_reuse: allowed because insert_assignments and update_assignments are separate semantic branches
multiplicity_constraints.upsert_insert_assignments: column_ref values must be unique within insert_assignments
multiplicity_constraints.upsert_update_assignments: column_ref values must be unique within update_assignments

rule: Verify that semantic write slots implied by the request are fully represented before SQL compilation.

creation_policy.free_text_input: use a pre-registered evidence span inventory; if span discovery needs an LLM, it is an explicit model-dependent upstream module and cannot be claimed deterministic
creation_policy.semi_structured_input: deterministically convert supplied source fields/evidence cells into SLOT_* before mapping

set_definitions.complete_iff: missing == empty and extra == empty and duplicate_required == empty and duplicate_mapped == empty and assignment_target_columns_unique == true
set_definitions.duplicate_mapped: any SLOT_i where count(mapped_occurrences[SLOT_i]) > 1 in the same mapping context
set_definitions.mapped: set(SLOT_* represented by accepted IR assignments and predicates)
set_definitions.mapped_occurrences: multiset/list of SLOT_* references represented by accepted IR assignments and predicates in the relevant context
